items.title: Apple (AAPL) Pushes Back As 24 7 Tokenized Shares Trading Opens
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) is challenging the trading of tokenized versions of its shares on newly expanded blockchain-based markets. Crypto exchange OKX and the New York Stock Exchange parent have launched a 24/7 tokenized U.S. securities venue that includes Apple, Nvidia, and Tesla. Apple and other issuers are raising questions over control of their equity's digital representation, shareholder rights, and regulatory oversight.
